analysis.title: Synopsys Inc. (SNPS): Expect a solid quarter, with FY27 outlook reflecting acceleration per Investor Day
key_insights: GS expects a solid FY4Q print for Synopsys, with FY27 guidance reflecting acceleration per the company's Investor Day growth framework.
GS expects FY4Q revenue toward the high end of company guidance and FY27 guidance in line with Investor Day targets.
GS raises FY26/27/28 non-GAAP EPS by about 2% on average. FY27/28 estimates are +1%/+4% vs. Street, reflecting modest upside to company targets.

Despite the recent sector-wide selloff, GS says investor positioning has turned more constructive in recent weeks following the Investor Day. Investor expectations have improved despite persistent concerns about AI's negative impact on software.
GS views Synopsys and Cadence as uniquely insulated from AI disruption, citing custom silicon designs, agentic AI adoption, and silicon-to-systems convergence.
GS sees the key growth vectors shifting toward AI-driven EDA monetization, while Design IP recovery remains more gradual.

Items on the call that could move the stock: AI monetization across three deployment models and GPT-Synopsys traction, custom IP momentum (~$1B Amazon agreement, new hyperscaler engagements, Factory 2 pipeline conversion), Ansys cross-selling and expansion, and hardware momentum (ZeBu demand, Artemis ahead of its 1H27 launch).
GS expects the post-print stock debate to center on EDA growth and AI monetization, execution on custom IP, and the pace of Ansys synergy realization.

market_movers.rationale: GS maintains its 12-month target of $600, based on 35x its normalized EPS estimate of $17.00. The target implies 37.8% upside from $435.51.

sector_views.rationale: GS views Synopsys and Cadence as insulated from AI disruption, with fundamentals improving on custom silicon, agentic AI adoption, and silicon-to-systems convergence.

earnings_insights: SNPS FY4Q (quarter ending 10/26E): GS estimates revenue $2,572mn vs. Street $2,563mn (+0.3%), and non-GAAP EPS excl. SBC $4.16 vs. Street $4.14 (+0.6%). Both are estimates, not reported results.
SNPS FY4Q GS estimate: non-GAAP operating margin excl. SBC 42.6% vs. Street 42.7%, with revenue growth of 14.1% y/y vs. Street 13.3%.
SNPS FY1Q27 GS estimate: revenue $2,729mn vs. Street $2,703mn (+1.0%), and non-GAAP EPS excl. SBC $4.62 vs. Street $4.57 (+1.0%). Both are estimates.
SNPS FY2027E GS estimate: revenue $11,141mn (+14.5% y/y) vs. Street $11,082mn, and non-GAAP EPS excl. SBC $19.20 vs. Street $18.97 (+1.2%). Prior GS EPS estimate was $19.25.
SNPS FY2028E GS estimate: revenue $12,664mn (+13.7% y/y) vs. Street $12,637mn, and non-GAAP EPS excl. SBC $24.00 vs. Street $23.19 (+3.5%). Prior GS EPS estimate was $22.50.
SNPS FY2026E GS estimate: revenue $9,733mn (+38.0% y/y), down 0.1% from the prior $9,740mn, and non-GAAP EPS excl. SBC $15.19, up from $15.15.
FY4Q segment estimates (GS vs. Street): EDA $1,306mn vs. $1,306mn, Design IP $480mn vs. $491mn (-2.2%), Simulation & Analysis (Ansys) $760mn vs. $747mn (+1.7%).
FY2027E segment estimates (GS vs. Street): EDA $5,529mn vs. $5,484mn (+0.8%), Design IP $2,177mn vs. $2,134mn (+2.0%), Simulation & Analysis $3,340mn vs. $3,323mn (+0.5%).
risk_factors: Persistent investor concern about AI's potentially negative impact on software
vol_and_positioning: GS says investor positioning in Synopsys has turned more constructive in recent weeks following the Investor Day, despite the recent sector-wide selloff.
Downside risks to the GS target: slower-than-expected AI monetization, export restrictions, market share losses, and fewer custom chip designs.
